skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Kal'tsit wore when she returned from Zelgrad. The massive device was not originally part of the design.
Everyone is discussing the changes in Kal'tsit, but no matter what, she still looks like a doctor.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Kal'tsit has gradually adapted to using the sarcophagus repair module, and her outfit and equipment have been adjusted accordingly.
Her life is fragile and real.
